<section id="python-api">
<h1>Python API</h1>
<p>The supported public API is exported from the top-level <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">phonodist</span></code> package. The package version is available as <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">phonodist.__version__</span></code>.</p>
<section id="core-functions">
<h2>Core functions</h2>
<section id="pronunciation-distance">
<h3><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">pronunciation_distance</span></code></h3>
<p>Computes the normalized <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">feature-align/1</span></code> distance.</p>
<dl class="py function">
<dt class="sig sig-object py" id="phonodist.pronunciation_distance">
<span class="sig-prename descclassname"><span class="pre">phonodist.</span></span><span class="sig-name descname"><span class="pre">pronunciation_distance</span></span><span class="sig-paren">(</span><em class="sig-param"><span class="n"><span class="pre">source</span></span></em>, <em class="sig-param"><span class="n"><span class="pre">target</span></span></em>, <em class="sig-param"><span class="keyword-only-separator o"><abbr title="Keyword-only parameters separator (PEP 3102)"><span class="pre">*</span></abbr></span></em>, <em class="sig-param"><span class="n"><span class="pre">language</span></span><span class="o"><span class="pre">=</span></span><span class="default_value"><span class="pre">None</span></span></em>, <em class="sig-param"><span class="n"><span class="pre">ignore_stress</span></span><span class="o"><span class="pre">=</span></span><span class="default_value"><span class="pre">None</span></span></em>, <em class="sig-param"><span class="n"><span class="pre">explain</span></span><span class="o"><span class="pre">=</span></span><span class="default_value"><span class="pre">False</span></span></em><span class="sig-paren">)</span><a class="reference internal" href="../_modules/phonodist/api/#pronunciation_distance"><span class="viewcode-link"><span class="pre">[source]</span></span></a></dt>
<dd><p>Compute normalized <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">feature-align/1</span></code> distance between IPA values.</p>
<dl class="field-list simple">
<dt class="field-odd">Parameters<span class="colon">:</span></dt>
<dd class="field-odd"><ul class="simple">
<li><p><strong>source</strong> (<a class="reference external" href="https://docs.python.org/3/builtins/stdtypes.html#str" title="(in Python v3.14)"><em>str</em></a>) – IPA pronunciations to compare.</p></li>
<li><p><strong>target</strong> (<a class="reference external" href="https://docs.python.org/3/builtins/stdtypes.html#str" title="(in Python v3.14)"><em>str</em></a>) – IPA pronunciations to compare.</p></li>
<li><p><strong>language</strong> (<a class="reference external" href="https://docs.python.org/3/builtins/stdtypes.html#str" title="(in Python v3.14)"><em>str</em></a><em> or </em><em>None</em>) – Language-profile tag; <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">None</span></code> selects universal mode without
language-specific profile rules.</p></li>
<li><p><strong>ignore_stress</strong> (<a class="reference external" href="https://docs.python.org/3/builtins/functions.html#bool" title="(in Python v3.14)"><em>bool</em></a><em> or </em><em>None</em>) – Stress policy passed to IPA parsing. <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">None</span></code> uses the selected profile’s
default, or ignores stress in universal mode. Explicit <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">False</span></code> is
unsupported by <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">feature-align/1</span></code> and raises <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">NotImplementedError</span></code>.</p></li>
<li><p><strong>explain</strong> (<a class="reference external" href="https://docs.python.org/3/builtins/functions.html#bool" title="(in Python v3.14)"><em>bool</em></a>) – If true, include the deterministic segment-alignment traceback in
<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">DistanceResult.operations</span></code>. The default score-only path returns an
empty operations tuple.</p></li>
</ul>
</dd>
<dt class="field-even">Returns<span class="colon">:</span></dt>
<dd class="field-even"><p>Normalized distance, raw alignment cost, denominator, parsed inputs,
optional operations, and metric/profile/backend provenance.</p>
</dd>
<dt class="field-odd">Return type<span class="colon">:</span></dt>
<dd class="field-odd"><p><a class="reference internal" href="#phonodist.DistanceResult" title="phonodist.DistanceResult">DistanceResult</a></p>
</dd>
<dt class="field-even">Raises<span class="colon">:</span></dt>
<dd class="field-even"><ul class="simple">
<li><p><a class="reference internal" href="#phonodist.InvalidIPAError" title="phonodist.InvalidIPAError"><strong>InvalidIPAError</strong></a> – If an input cannot be normalized into parseable IPA.</p></li>
<li><p><a class="reference internal" href="#phonodist.UnknownLanguageProfileError" title="phonodist.UnknownLanguageProfileError"><strong>UnknownLanguageProfileError</strong></a> – If <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">language</span></code> does not resolve to a bundled profile.</p></li>
<li><p><a class="reference internal" href="#phonodist.UnknownSegmentError" title="phonodist.UnknownSegmentError"><strong>UnknownSegmentError</strong></a> – If the selected feature backend cannot represent an input segment.</p></li>
<li><p><a class="reference external" href="https://docs.python.org/3/builtins/exceptions.html#NotImplementedError" title="(in Python v3.14)"><strong>NotImplementedError</strong></a> – If <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">ignore_stress=False</span></code> requests unimplemented stress-sensitive scoring.</p></li>
</ul>
</dd>
</dl>
<p class="rubric">Notes</p>
<p>The score is bounded to <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">[0,</span> <span class="pre">1]</span></code> and is not a calibrated human perceptual
distance. Score-only and traceback modes are intended to produce the same
score; <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">explain=True</span></code> adds operation detail. Stress is ignored by this
metric. Use <a class="reference internal" href="#phonodist.compare_pronunciations" title="phonodist.compare_pronunciations"><code class="xref py py-func docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">compare_pronunciations()</span></code></a> for structural stress diagnostics.</p>
</dd></dl>

</section>
<section id="compare-pronunciations">
<h3><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">compare_pronunciations</span></code></h3>
<p>Returns an <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">ipa-compare/1</span></code> structural comparison with an embedded segmental distance result.</p>
<dl class="py function">
<dt class="sig sig-object py" id="phonodist.compare_pronunciations">
<span class="sig-prename descclassname"><span class="pre">phonodist.</span></span><span class="sig-name descname"><span class="pre">compare_pronunciations</span></span><span class="sig-paren">(</span><em class="sig-param"><span class="n"><span class="pre">source</span></span></em>, <em class="sig-param"><span class="n"><span class="pre">target</span></span></em>, <em class="sig-param"><span class="keyword-only-separator o"><abbr title="Keyword-only parameters separator (PEP 3102)"><span class="pre">*</span></abbr></span></em>, <em class="sig-param"><span class="n"><span class="pre">language</span></span><span class="o"><span class="pre">=</span></span><span class="default_value"><span class="pre">None</span></span></em>, <em class="sig-param"><span class="n"><span class="pre">explain</span></span><span class="o"><span class="pre">=</span></span><span class="default_value"><span class="pre">False</span></span></em><span class="sig-paren">)</span><a class="reference internal" href="../_modules/phonodist/api/#compare_pronunciations"><span class="viewcode-link"><span class="pre">[source]</span></span></a></dt>
<dd><p>Classify structural differences between two IPA pronunciations.</p>
<dl class="field-list simple">
<dt class="field-odd">Parameters<span class="colon">:</span></dt>
<dd class="field-odd"><ul class="simple">
<li><p><strong>source</strong> (<a class="reference external" href="https://docs.python.org/3/builtins/stdtypes.html#str" title="(in Python v3.14)"><em>str</em></a>) – IPA pronunciations to compare.</p></li>
<li><p><strong>target</strong> (<a class="reference external" href="https://docs.python.org/3/builtins/stdtypes.html#str" title="(in Python v3.14)"><em>str</em></a>) – IPA pronunciations to compare.</p></li>
<li><p><strong>language</strong> (<a class="reference external" href="https://docs.python.org/3/builtins/stdtypes.html#str" title="(in Python v3.14)"><em>str</em></a><em> or </em><em>None</em>) – Optional language-profile tag for notation aliases and sequence
equivalences; <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">None</span></code> uses universal rules.</p></li>
<li><p><strong>explain</strong> (<a class="reference external" href="https://docs.python.org/3/builtins/functions.html#bool" title="(in Python v3.14)"><em>bool</em></a>) – If true, include segment-alignment and stress-operation details.</p></li>
</ul>
</dd>
<dt class="field-even">Returns<span class="colon">:</span></dt>
<dd class="field-even"><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">ipa-compare/1</span></code> classification, canonical sides, anchored stress
events, and an embedded stress-free <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">feature-align/1</span></code> result.</p>
</dd>
<dt class="field-odd">Return type<span class="colon">:</span></dt>
<dd class="field-odd"><p><a class="reference internal" href="#phonodist.PronunciationComparison" title="phonodist.PronunciationComparison">PronunciationComparison</a></p>
</dd>
<dt class="field-even">Raises<span class="colon">:</span></dt>
<dd class="field-even"><ul class="simple">
<li><p><a class="reference internal" href="#phonodist.InvalidIPAError" title="phonodist.InvalidIPAError"><strong>InvalidIPAError</strong></a> – If an input contains no parseable IPA content.</p></li>
<li><p><a class="reference internal" href="#phonodist.UnknownLanguageProfileError" title="phonodist.UnknownLanguageProfileError"><strong>UnknownLanguageProfileError</strong></a> – If <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">language</span></code> does not resolve to a bundled profile.</p></li>
<li><p><a class="reference internal" href="#phonodist.UnknownSegmentError" title="phonodist.UnknownSegmentError"><strong>UnknownSegmentError</strong></a> – If the feature backend cannot represent an input segment.</p></li>
</ul>
</dd>
</dl>
<p class="rubric">Notes</p>
<p>Stress anchors count canonical segments preceding each stress mark. The
classification is structural, not a calibrated stress-distance model or a
judgment about which pronunciation is correct. The profile is optional.</p>
</dd></dl>

</section>
<section id="parse-ipa">
<h3><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">parse_ipa</span></code></h3>
<p>Normalizes and parses IPA into a public parsed-pronunciation result.</p>
<dl class="py function">
<dt class="sig sig-object py" id="phonodist.parse_ipa">
<span class="sig-prename descclassname"><span class="pre">phonodist.</span></span><span class="sig-name descname"><span class="pre">parse_ipa</span></span><span class="sig-paren">(</span><em class="sig-param"><span class="n"><span class="pre">value</span></span></em>, <em class="sig-param"><span class="keyword-only-separator o"><abbr title="Keyword-only parameters separator (PEP 3102)"><span class="pre">*</span></abbr></span></em>, <em class="sig-param"><span class="n"><span class="pre">language</span></span><span class="o"><span class="pre">=</span></span><span class="default_value"><span class="pre">None</span></span></em>, <em class="sig-param"><span class="n"><span class="pre">ignore_stress</span></span><span class="o"><span class="pre">=</span></span><span class="default_value"><span class="pre">None</span></span></em><span class="sig-paren">)</span><a class="reference internal" href="../_modules/phonodist/api/#parse_ipa"><span class="viewcode-link"><span class="pre">[source]</span></span></a></dt>
<dd><p>Normalize IPA text and split it into IPA units.</p>
<dl class="field-list simple">
<dt class="field-odd">Parameters<span class="colon">:</span></dt>
<dd class="field-odd"><ul class="simple">
<li><p><strong>value</strong> (<a class="reference external" href="https://docs.python.org/3/builtins/stdtypes.html#str" title="(in Python v3.14)"><em>str</em></a>) – IPA string to normalize. Matching outer <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">/.../</span></code> or <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">[...]</span></code> delimiters
and surrounding whitespace are stripped.</p></li>
<li><p><strong>language</strong> (<a class="reference external" href="https://docs.python.org/3/builtins/stdtypes.html#str" title="(in Python v3.14)"><em>str</em></a><em> or </em><em>None</em>) – Bundled language-profile tag used for profile defaults and notation aliases.
<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">None</span></code> selects universal parsing. Aliases include <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">de</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">de-DE</span></code>, and
<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">de_de</span></code> for the German profile.</p></li>
<li><p><strong>ignore_stress</strong> (<a class="reference external" href="https://docs.python.org/3/builtins/functions.html#bool" title="(in Python v3.14)"><em>bool</em></a><em> or </em><em>None</em>) – Whether to remove primary/secondary stress markers. <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">None</span></code> uses the
selected profile’s default; in universal mode it defaults to <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">True</span></code>.</p></li>
</ul>
</dd>
<dt class="field-even">Returns<span class="colon">:</span></dt>
<dd class="field-even"><p>Original and normalized text, canonical segment units, and diagnostics.</p>
</dd>
<dt class="field-odd">Return type<span class="colon">:</span></dt>
<dd class="field-odd"><p><a class="reference internal" href="#phonodist.ParsedPronunciation" title="phonodist.ParsedPronunciation">ParsedPronunciation</a></p>
</dd>
<dt class="field-even">Raises<span class="colon">:</span></dt>
<dd class="field-even"><ul class="simple">
<li><p><a class="reference internal" href="#phonodist.InvalidIPAError" title="phonodist.InvalidIPAError"><strong>InvalidIPAError</strong></a> – If <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">value</span></code> is not a string or a non-empty value normalizes to no parseable content.</p></li>
<li><p><a class="reference internal" href="#phonodist.UnknownLanguageProfileError" title="phonodist.UnknownLanguageProfileError"><strong>UnknownLanguageProfileError</strong></a> – If <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">language</span></code> does not resolve to a bundled profile.</p></li>
</ul>
</dd>
</dl>
<p class="rubric">Notes</p>
<p>Normalization applies NFC, ignores internal whitespace and Unicode format
characters, and canonicalizes supported tie-bar variants. It does not check
whether every segment is supported by the metric’s feature backend.</p>
</dd></dl>

</section>
<section id="segment-distance">
<h3><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">segment_distance</span></code></h3>
<p>Returns a feature distance for two IPA segments.</p>
<dl class="py function">
<dt class="sig sig-object py" id="phonodist.segment_distance">
<span class="sig-prename descclassname"><span class="pre">phonodist.</span></span><span class="sig-name descname"><span class="pre">segment_distance</span></span><span class="sig-paren">(</span><em class="sig-param"><span class="n"><span class="pre">left</span></span></em>, <em class="sig-param"><span class="n"><span class="pre">right</span></span></em><span class="sig-paren">)</span><a class="reference internal" href="../_modules/phonodist/api/#segment_distance"><span class="viewcode-link"><span class="pre">[source]</span></span></a></dt>
<dd><p>Return normalized PanPhon feature distance for two IPA segments.</p>
<dl class="field-list simple">
<dt class="field-odd">Parameters<span class="colon">:</span></dt>
<dd class="field-odd"><ul class="simple">
<li><p><strong>left</strong> (<a class="reference external" href="https://docs.python.org/3/builtins/stdtypes.html#str" title="(in Python v3.14)"><em>str</em></a>) – IPA segments to compare. Each value must be recognized as exactly one
segment by the PanPhon backend.</p></li>
<li><p><strong>right</strong> (<a class="reference external" href="https://docs.python.org/3/builtins/stdtypes.html#str" title="(in Python v3.14)"><em>str</em></a>) – IPA segments to compare. Each value must be recognized as exactly one
segment by the PanPhon backend.</p></li>
</ul>
</dd>
<dt class="field-even">Returns<span class="colon">:</span></dt>
<dd class="field-even"><p>Unweighted feature difference normalized to <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">[0,</span> <span class="pre">1]</span></code>.</p>
</dd>
<dt class="field-odd">Return type<span class="colon">:</span></dt>
<dd class="field-odd"><p><a class="reference external" href="https://docs.python.org/3/builtins/functions.html#float" title="(in Python v3.14)">float</a></p>
</dd>
<dt class="field-even">Raises<span class="colon">:</span></dt>
<dd class="field-even"><p><a class="reference internal" href="#phonodist.UnknownSegmentError" title="phonodist.UnknownSegmentError"><strong>UnknownSegmentError</strong></a> – If either input is not a supported single segment or their feature
    vectors are incompatible.</p>
</dd>
</dl>
</dd></dl>

</section>
</section>
<section id="profiles">
<h2>Profiles</h2>
<dl class="py function">
<dt class="sig sig-object py" id="phonodist.available_profiles">
<span class="sig-prename descclassname"><span class="pre">phonodist.</span></span><span class="sig-name descname"><span class="pre">available_profiles</span></span><span class="sig-paren">(</span><span class="sig-paren">)</span><a class="reference internal" href="../_modules/phonodist/profiles/#available_profiles"><span class="viewcode-link"><span class="pre">[source]</span></span></a></dt>
<dd><p>Return identifiers of the profiles bundled in this package.</p>
<dl class="field-list simple">
<dt class="field-odd">Returns<span class="colon">:</span></dt>
<dd class="field-odd"><p>Canonical IDs for profiles currently bundled with this package. The
current set is <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">(&quot;de-DE&quot;,)</span></code>; this is not dynamic profile discovery.</p>
</dd>
<dt class="field-even">Return type<span class="colon">:</span></dt>
<dd class="field-even"><p><a class="reference external" href="https://docs.python.org/3/builtins/stdtypes.html#tuple" title="(in Python v3.14)">tuple</a> of <a class="reference external" href="https://docs.python.org/3/builtins/stdtypes.html#str" title="(in Python v3.14)">str</a></p>
</dd>
</dl>
</dd></dl>

<dl class="py function">
<dt class="sig sig-object py" id="phonodist.get_profile">
<span class="sig-prename descclassname"><span class="pre">phonodist.</span></span><span class="sig-name descname"><span class="pre">get_profile</span></span><span class="sig-paren">(</span><em class="sig-param"><span class="n"><span class="pre">language</span></span></em><span class="sig-paren">)</span><a class="reference internal" href="../_modules/phonodist/profiles/#get_profile"><span class="viewcode-link"><span class="pre">[source]</span></span></a></dt>
<dd><p>Load a bundled language profile by ID or supported alias.</p>
<dl class="field-list simple">
<dt class="field-odd">Parameters<span class="colon">:</span></dt>
<dd class="field-odd"><p><strong>language</strong> (<a class="reference external" href="https://docs.python.org/3/builtins/stdtypes.html#str" title="(in Python v3.14)"><em>str</em></a>) – Profile identifier. For the bundled German profile, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">de</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">de-DE</span></code>,
and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">de_de</span></code> resolve to canonical ID <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">de-DE</span></code> (case-insensitively).</p>
</dd>
<dt class="field-even">Returns<span class="colon">:</span></dt>
<dd class="field-even"><p>Immutable profile metadata and sparse rules.</p>
</dd>
<dt class="field-odd">Return type<span class="colon">:</span></dt>
<dd class="field-odd"><p><a class="reference internal" href="#phonodist.LanguageProfile" title="phonodist.LanguageProfile">LanguageProfile</a></p>
</dd>
<dt class="field-even">Raises<span class="colon">:</span></dt>
<dd class="field-even"><ul class="simple">
<li><p><a class="reference internal" href="#phonodist.UnknownLanguageProfileError" title="phonodist.UnknownLanguageProfileError"><strong>UnknownLanguageProfileError</strong></a> – If no bundled profile matches the normalized identifier.</p></li>
<li><p><a class="reference internal" href="#phonodist.ProfileValidationError" title="phonodist.ProfileValidationError"><strong>ProfileValidationError</strong></a> – If the profile data is invalid.</p></li>
</ul>
</dd>
</dl>
</dd></dl>

<p>Profile names and aliases are described in <a class="reference internal" href="../PROFILES/"><span class="std std-doc">Language profiles</span></a>.</p>
</section>
<section id="distance-results">
<h2>Distance results</h2>
<dl class="py class">
<dt class="sig sig-object py" id="phonodist.DistanceResult">
<span class="property"><span class="k"><span class="pre">class</span></span><span class="w"> </span></span><span class="sig-prename descclassname"><span class="pre">phonodist.</span></span><span class="sig-name descname"><span class="pre">DistanceResult</span></span><span class="sig-paren">(</span><em class="sig-param"><span class="n"><span class="pre">distance</span></span></em>, <em class="sig-param"><span class="n"><span class="pre">raw_cost</span></span></em>, <em class="sig-param"><span class="n"><span class="pre">denominator</span></span></em>, <em class="sig-param"><span class="n"><span class="pre">source</span></span></em>, <em class="sig-param"><span class="n"><span class="pre">target</span></span></em>, <em class="sig-param"><span class="n"><span class="pre">operations</span></span></em>, <em class="sig-param"><span class="n"><span class="pre">metric</span></span></em>, <em class="sig-param"><span class="n"><span class="pre">metric_version</span></span></em>, <em class="sig-param"><span class="n"><span class="pre">language</span></span></em>, <em class="sig-param"><span class="n"><span class="pre">profile_version</span></span></em>, <em class="sig-param"><span class="n"><span class="pre">backend</span></span></em>, <em class="sig-param"><span class="n"><span class="pre">backend_version</span></span></em>, <em class="sig-param"><span class="n"><span class="pre">feature_set</span></span></em><span class="sig-paren">)</span><a class="reference internal" href="../_modules/phonodist/model/#DistanceResult"><span class="viewcode-link"><span class="pre">[source]</span></span></a></dt>
<dd><p>Bases: <a class="reference external" href="https://docs.python.org/3/builtins/functions.html#object" title="(in Python v3.14)"><code class="xref py py-class docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">object</span></code></a></p>
<p>Score, optional traceback, and provenance for <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">feature-align/1</span></code>.</p>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">distance</span></code> is normalized to <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">[0,</span> <span class="pre">1]</span></code> as <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">raw_cost</span> <span class="pre">/</span> <span class="pre">denominator</span></code>;
it is zero when both segment sequences are empty. A zero score can result
from canonicalization or a zero-cost profile equivalence, not only identical
original strings.</p>
<dl class="field-list simple">
<dt class="field-odd">Parameters<span class="colon">:</span></dt>
<dd class="field-odd"><ul class="simple">
<li><p><strong>distance</strong> (<a class="reference external" href="https://docs.python.org/3/builtins/functions.html#float" title="(in Python v3.14)"><em>float</em></a>)</p></li>
<li><p><strong>raw_cost</strong> (<a class="reference external" href="https://docs.python.org/3/builtins/functions.html#float" title="(in Python v3.14)"><em>float</em></a>)</p></li>
<li><p><strong>denominator</strong> (<a class="reference external" href="https://docs.python.org/3/builtins/functions.html#float" title="(in Python v3.14)"><em>float</em></a>)</p></li>
<li><p><strong>source</strong> (<a class="reference internal" href="#phonodist.ParsedPronunciation" title="phonodist.model.ParsedPronunciation"><em>ParsedPronunciation</em></a>)</p></li>
<li><p><strong>target</strong> (<a class="reference internal" href="#phonodist.ParsedPronunciation" title="phonodist.model.ParsedPronunciation"><em>ParsedPronunciation</em></a>)</p></li>
<li><p><strong>operations</strong> (<a class="reference external" href="https://docs.python.org/3/builtins/stdtypes.html#tuple" title="(in Python v3.14)"><em>tuple</em></a><em>[</em><a class="reference internal" href="#phonodist.AlignmentOperation" title="phonodist.model.AlignmentOperation"><em>AlignmentOperation</em></a><em>, </em><em>...</em><em>]</em>)</p></li>
<li><p><strong>metric</strong> (<a class="reference external" href="https://docs.python.org/3/builtins/stdtypes.html#str" title="(in Python v3.14)"><em>str</em></a>)</p></li>
<li><p><strong>metric_version</strong> (<a class="reference external" href="https://docs.python.org/3/builtins/stdtypes.html#str" title="(in Python v3.14)"><em>str</em></a>)</p></li>
<li><p><strong>language</strong> (<a class="reference external" href="https://docs.python.org/3/builtins/stdtypes.html#str" title="(in Python v3.14)"><em>str</em></a><em> | </em><em>None</em>)</p></li>
<li><p><strong>profile_version</strong> (<a class="reference external" href="https://docs.python.org/3/builtins/stdtypes.html#str" title="(in Python v3.14)"><em>str</em></a><em> | </em><em>None</em>)</p></li>
<li><p><strong>backend</strong> (<a class="reference external" href="https://docs.python.org/3/builtins/stdtypes.html#str" title="(in Python v3.14)"><em>str</em></a>)</p></li>
<li><p><strong>backend_version</strong> (<a class="reference external" href="https://docs.python.org/3/builtins/stdtypes.html#str" title="(in Python v3.14)"><em>str</em></a>)</p></li>
<li><p><strong>feature_set</strong> (<a class="reference external" href="https://docs.python.org/3/builtins/stdtypes.html#str" title="(in Python v3.14)"><em>str</em></a>)</p></li>
</ul>
</dd>
</dl>

</dd>
</dl>
</dd></dl>

Their structural meanings are explained in <a class="reference internal" href="../COMPARISON/"><span class="std std-doc">Structural IPA comparison</span></a>.</p>

<section id="language-profiles">
<h2>Language profiles</h2>
<dl class="py class">
<dt class="sig sig-object py" id="phonodist.LanguageProfile">
<span class="property"><span class="k"><span class="pre">class</span></span><span class="w"> </span></span><span class="sig-prename descclassname"><span class="pre">phonodist.</span></span><span class="sig-name descname"><span class="pre">LanguageProfile</span></span><span class="sig-paren">(</span><em class="sig-param"><span class="n"><span class="pre">id</span></span></em>, <em class="sig-param"><span class="n"><span class="pre">version</span></span></em>, <em class="sig-param"><span class="n"><span class="pre">name</span></span></em>, <em class="sig-param"><span class="n"><span class="pre">default_ignore_stress</span></span></em>, <em class="sig-param"><span class="n"><span class="pre">inventory</span></span></em>, <em class="sig-param"><span class="n"><span class="pre">aliases</span></span></em>, <em class="sig-param"><span class="n"><span class="pre">sequence_equivalences</span></span></em>, <em class="sig-param"><span class="n"><span class="pre">sources</span></span></em><span class="sig-paren">)</span><a class="reference internal" href="../_modules/phonodist/model/#LanguageProfile"><span class="viewcode-link"><span class="pre">[source]</span></span></a></dt>
<dd><p>Bases: <a class="reference external" href="https://docs.python.org/3/builtins/functions.html#object" title="(in Python v3.14)"><code class="xref py py-class docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">object</span></code></a></p>
<p>Bundled language-specific defaults and sparse IPA comparison rules.</p>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">inventory</span></code> is descriptive metadata, not an exhaustive segment
rejection list; metric v1 uses PanPhon as the authority for feature
availability.</p>
<dl class="field-list simple">
<dt class="field-odd">Parameters<span class="colon">:</span></dt>
<dd class="field-odd"><ul class="simple">
<li><p><strong>id</strong> (<a class="reference external" href="https://docs.python.org/3/builtins/stdtypes.html#str" title="(in Python v3.14)"><em>str</em></a>)</p></li>
<li><p><strong>version</strong> (<a class="reference external" href="https://docs.python.org/3/builtins/stdtypes.html#str" title="(in Python v3.14)"><em>str</em></a>)</p></li>
<li><p><strong>name</strong> (<a class="reference external" href="https://docs.python.org/3/builtins/stdtypes.html#str" title="(in Python v3.14)"><em>str</em></a>)</p></li>
<li><p><strong>default_ignore_stress</strong> (<a class="reference external" href="https://docs.python.org/3/builtins/functions.html#bool" title="(in Python v3.14)"><em>bool</em></a>)</p></li>
<li><p><strong>inventory</strong> (<a class="reference external" href="https://docs.python.org/3/builtins/stdtypes.html#tuple" title="(in Python v3.14)"><em>tuple</em></a><em>[</em><a class="reference external" href="https://docs.python.org/3/builtins/stdtypes.html#str" title="(in Python v3.14)"><em>str</em></a><em>, </em><em>...</em><em>]</em>)</p></li>
<li><p><strong>aliases</strong> (<a class="reference external" href="https://docs.python.org/3/builtins/stdtypes.html#tuple" title="(in Python v3.14)"><em>tuple</em></a><em>[</em><em>AliasRule</em><em>, </em><em>...</em><em>]</em>)</p></li>
<li><p><strong>sequence_equivalences</strong> (<a class="reference external" href="https://docs.python.org/3/builtins/stdtypes.html#tuple" title="(in Python v3.14)"><em>tuple</em></a><em>[</em><em>SequenceEquivalence</em><em>, </em><em>...</em><em>]</em>)</p></li>
<li><p><strong>sources</strong> (<a class="reference external" href="https://docs.python.org/3/builtins/stdtypes.html#tuple" title="(in Python v3.14)"><em>tuple</em></a><em>[</em><a class="reference external" href="https://docs.python.org/3/builtins/stdtypes.html#str" title="(in Python v3.14)"><em>str</em></a><em>, </em><em>...</em><em>]</em>)</p></li>

<section id="exceptions">
<h2>Exceptions</h2>
<p>All package domain exceptions inherit from <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">PhonodistError</span></code>.</p>
<dl class="py exception">
<dt class="sig sig-object py" id="phonodist.PhonodistError">
<span class="property"><span class="k"><span class="pre">exception</span></span><span class="w"> </span></span><span class="sig-prename descclassname"><span class="pre">phonodist.</span></span><span class="sig-name descname"><span class="pre">PhonodistError</span></span><a class="reference internal" href="../_modules/phonodist/errors/#PhonodistError"><span class="viewcode-link"><span class="pre">[source]</span></span></a></dt>
<dd><p>Bases: <a class="reference external" href="https://docs.python.org/3/builtins/exceptions.html#Exception" title="(in Python v3.14)"><code class="xref py py-class docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">Exception</span></code></a></p>

</dd></dl>

<dl class="py exception">
<dt class="sig sig-object py" id="phonodist.InvalidIPAError">
<span class="property"><span class="k"><span class="pre">exception</span></span><span class="w"> </span></span><span class="sig-prename descclassname"><span class="pre">phonodist.</span></span><span class="sig-name descname"><span class="pre">InvalidIPAError</span></span><a class="reference internal" href="../_modules/phonodist/errors/#InvalidIPAError"><span class="viewcode-link"><span class="pre">[source]</span></span></a></dt>
<dd><p>Bases: <a class="reference internal" href="#phonodist.PhonodistError" title="phonodist.errors.PhonodistError"><code class="xref py py-class docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">PhonodistError</span></code></a></p>
<p>Raised when an IPA value cannot be normalized or parsed.</p>
</dd></dl>

<dl class="py exception">
<dt class="sig sig-object py" id="phonodist.UnknownSegmentError">
<span class="property"><span class="k"><span class="pre">exception</span></span><span class="w"> </span></span><span class="sig-prename descclassname"><span class="pre">phonodist.</span></span><span class="sig-name descname"><span class="pre">UnknownSegmentError</span></span><a class="reference internal" href="../_modules/phonodist/errors/#UnknownSegmentError"><span class="viewcode-link"><span class="pre">[source]</span></span></a></dt>
<dd><p>Bases: <a class="reference internal" href="#phonodist.PhonodistError" title="phonodist.errors.PhonodistError"><code class="xref py py-class docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">PhonodistError</span></code></a></p>
<p>Raised when the feature backend cannot represent an IPA segment.</p>
</dd></dl>

<dl class="py exception">
<dt class="sig sig-object py" id="phonodist.UnknownLanguageProfileError">
<span class="property"><span class="k"><span class="pre">exception</span></span><span class="w"> </span></span><span class="sig-prename descclassname"><span class="pre">phonodist.</span></span><span class="sig-name descname"><span class="pre">UnknownLanguageProfileError</span></span><a class="reference internal" href="../_modules/phonodist/errors/#UnknownLanguageProfileError"><span class="viewcode-link"><span class="pre">[source]</span></span></a></dt>
<dd><p>Bases: <a class="reference internal" href="#phonodist.PhonodistError" title="phonodist.errors.PhonodistError"><code class="xref py py-class docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">PhonodistError</span></code></a></p>
<p>Raised when a requested language profile is unavailable.</p>
</dd></dl>

<dl class="py exception">
<dt class="sig sig-object py" id="phonodist.ProfileValidationError">
<span class="property"><span class="k"><span class="pre">exception</span></span><span class="w"> </span></span><span class="sig-prename descclassname"><span class="pre">phonodist.</span></span><span class="sig-name descname"><span class="pre">ProfileValidationError</span></span><a class="reference internal" href="../_modules/phonodist/errors/#ProfileValidationError"><span class="viewcode-link"><span class="pre">[source]</span></span></a></dt>
<dd><p>Bases: <a class="reference internal" href="#phonodist.PhonodistError" title="phonodist.errors.PhonodistError"><code class="xref py py-class docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">PhonodistError</span></code></a></p>
<p>Raised when bundled or supplied profile data is invalid.</p>
</dd></dl>

<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">InvalidIPAError</span></code> reports malformed or invalid input. <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">UnknownSegmentError</span></code> reports IPA segments unsupported by the configured feature backend. <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">UnknownLanguageProfileError</span></code> reports a language tag without a bundled profile; <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">ProfileValidationError</span></code> reports invalid profile data.</p>
</section>
</section>
</div>
<script data-sphinxpress-script="search" defer>
(function () {
  "use strict";

  function initForm(form) {
    var input = form.querySelector(".tool-search-input");
    var results = form.querySelector(".tool-search-results");
    var navList = form.parentElement
      ? form.parentElement.querySelector(".tool-nav-list")
      : null;
    if (!input || !results) {
      return;
    }
    var emptyText = form.getAttribute("data-search-empty") || "No matches.";
    var indexUrl = form.getAttribute("data-search-index");
    if (!indexUrl) {
      hideForm();
      return;
    }

    var indexEntries = null;
    var indexError = false;
    var pendingQuery = null;

    function hideForm() {
      form.style.display = "none";
    }

    function escapeHtml(value) {
      return value
        .replace(/&/g, "&amp;")
        .replace(/</g, "&lt;")
        .replace(/>/g, "&gt;")
        .replace(/"/g, "&quot;")
        .replace(/'/g, "&#39;");
    }

    function showEmpty() {
      results.innerHTML =
        '<p class="tool-search-empty">' + escapeHtml(emptyText) + "</p>";
      results.hidden = false;
      if (navList) {
        navList.hidden = true;
      }
    }

    function clearResults() {
      results.innerHTML = "";
      results.hidden = true;
      if (navList) {
        navList.hidden = false;
      }
    }

    function renderResults(entries, tokens) {
      if (!entries.length) {
        showEmpty();
        return;
      }
      var html = entries
        .map(function (entry) {
          var snippetHtml = renderSnippet(entry, tokens);
          var href = entry.url + "#sphinxpress-search-hit";
          return (
            '<li class="tool-search-result">' +
            '<a href="' +
            escapeHtml(href) +
            '">' +
            '<p class="tool-search-result-title">' +
            escapeHtml(entry.title) +
            "</p>" +
            '<p class="tool-search-result-snippet">' +
            snippetHtml +
            "</p>" +
            "</a>" +
            "</li>"
          );
        })
        .join("");
      results.innerHTML = html;
      results.hidden = false;
      if (navList) {
        navList.hidden = true;
      }
    }

    function renderSnippet(entry, tokens) {
      var source = entry.snippet || "";
      if (!source) {
        return "";
      }
      var lower = source.toLowerCase();
      var firstToken = tokens[0] || "";
      var idx = lower.indexOf(firstToken);
      if (idx < 0) {
        return escapeHtml(source);
      }
      var before = source.slice(0, idx);
      var match = source.slice(idx, idx + firstToken.length);
      var after = source.slice(idx + firstToken.length);
      return (
        escapeHtml(before) +
        "<mark>" +
        escapeHtml(match) +
        "</mark>" +
        escapeHtml(after)
      );
    }

    function runQuery(query) {
      if (!indexEntries) {
        return;
      }
      var tokens = query
        .toLowerCase()
        .split(/\s+/)
        .filter(function (token) {
          return token.length > 0;
        });
      if (!tokens.length) {
        clearResults();
        return;
      }
      var hits = [];
      for (var i = 0; i < indexEntries.length; i += 1) {
        var entry = indexEntries[i];
        if (!entry.sections || !entry.sections.length) {
          continue;
        }
        var matched = true;
        var score = 0;
        for (var t = 0; t < tokens.length; t += 1) {
          var token = tokens[t];
          var found = false;
          var tokenScore = 0;
          for (var s = 0; s < entry.sections.length; s += 1) {
            var section = entry.sections[s];
            var lowerText = section.lower || "";
            if (!lowerText) {
              continue;
            }
            var from = 0;
            while (from <= lowerText.length) {
              var foundAt = lowerText.indexOf(token, from);
              if (foundAt < 0) {
                break;
              }
              tokenScore += 1;
              from = foundAt + token.length;
            }
            if (tokenScore > 0) {
              found = true;
            }
          }
          if (!found) {
            matched = false;
            break;
          }
          score += tokenScore;
        }
        if (matched) {
          hits.push({ entry: entry, score: score });
        }
      }
      hits.sort(function (a, b) {
        return b.score - a.score;
      });
      var top = hits.slice(0, 20).map(function (hit) {
        return hit.entry;
      });
      renderResults(top, tokens);
    }

    function handleInput() {
      var query = input.value || "";
      if (!query.trim()) {
        clearResults();
        pendingQuery = null;
        return;
      }
      if (indexError) {
        hideForm();
        return;
      }
      if (indexEntries) {
        runQuery(query);
      } else {
        pendingQuery = query;
      }
    }

    input.addEventListener("input", handleInput);

    fetch(indexUrl, { credentials: "same-origin" })
      .then(function (response) {
        if (!response.ok) {
          throw new Error("HTTP " + response.status);
        }
        return response.json();
      })
      .then(function (payload) {
        if (
          !payload ||
          !Array.isArray(payload.entries) ||
          payload.entries.length === 0
        ) {
          hideForm();
          return;
        }
        indexEntries = payload.entries;
        if (pendingQuery) {
          runQuery(pendingQuery);
        }
      })
      .catch(function () {
        indexError = true;
        if (input.value && input.value.trim()) {
          hideForm();
        } else {
          hideForm();
        }
      });
  }

  function init() {
    var forms = document.querySelectorAll("form.tool-search");
    for (var i = 0; i < forms.length; i += 1) {
      initForm(forms[i]);
    }
  }

  if (document.readyState === "loading") {
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", init);
  } else {
    init();
  }
})();

</script>
